basic_info.description: First time ever being offered for sale! This home has been lovingly cared for since being built by the current owners' family in 1956. The sleek midcentury design features a tunnel entrance with terrazzo stairs that lead to the main level. Once inside, you will appreciate the very rare 3 bedroom, 1.5 Bath floor plan with L shape living and dining rooms. Living/Dining areas feature beautiful parquet floors, large dual pane windows that soak the home with natural light, and a wood-burning fireplace. The bedrooms are of ample sizes and feature wood floors and dual pane windows. The large eat in kitchen has classic tile countertops. Bathrooms also feature original tile in the full bathroom and half bathroom. Large bonus room in the basement perfect for an office or creative space.  The backyard is low maintenance with mature trees adding some privacy. Location is ideal, close to San Bruno Ave, highway 101/280 and public transportation. A very special home with great bones, just in time for holidays!
